dedupe_keys.name: cartographies de simulation d inondations par la mer a quiberville en fonction de niveaux marins extremes

description: Cartographies de simulation d'inondations par la mer à Quiberville en fonction de niveaux marins extrêmes is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Simulation of floods by sea according to topography (from an LIDAR) and variations in sea levels. A mapping is carried out every 10cm of sea level rise, from the 10-year return level to the 100-year return level plus 1 meter. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Sea flood simulation maps in Quiberville based on extreme sea levels" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include seine maritime. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
